mapper.select: SELECT id, system_name, logo_url, favicon_url, system_description, copyright_info, home_title, login_background_url, theme_color, timezone, datetime_format, default_page_size, max_upload_size_mb, allowed_upload_types, record_number, official_website, contact_email, service_phone, version, update_by, create_time, update_time FROM `system_setting` WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE `system_setting` SET system_name = #{setting.systemName}, logo_url = #{setting.logoUrl}, favicon_url = #{setting.faviconUrl}, system_description = #{setting.systemDescription}, copyright_info = #{setting.copyrightInfo}, home_title = #{setting.homeTitle}, login_background_url = #{setting.loginBackgroundUrl}, theme_color = #{setting.themeColor}, timezone = #{setting.timezone}, datetime_format = #{setting.datetimeFormat}, default_page_size = #{setting.defaultPageSize}, max_upload_size_mb = #{setting.maxUploadSizeMb}, allowed_upload_types = #{setting.allowedUploadTypes}, record_number = #{setting.recordNumber}, official_website = #{setting.officialWebsite}, contact_email = #{setting.contactEmail}, service_phone = #{setting.servicePhone}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = 1 AND version = #{setting.version}
